a: Even if your opponent doesn't have 5 or more cards in their hand, this card's [Main] effect will delete 1 of their Digimon with a level equal to or higher than the number of cards in their hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: [Main] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or higher a level as the number of cards in their hand.
